title: Streaming SSR
definition: Instead of waiting for an entire React app to render to HTML on the server before sending it, Streaming SSR sends the HTML in chunks over a persistent HTTP connection. The user sees the header instantly while the heavy body content is still generating.
simpleExplanation: Like watching a YouTube video while it's still downloading. The server sends you the top half of the webpage instantly while it's still calculating the bottom half.

basic: What are the core requirements for Streaming SSR?
intermediate: How do you handle edge cases and accessibility in Streaming SSR?
advanced: How do you scale and optimize Streaming SSR for millions of concurrent users?
trick: What happens to Streaming SSR if JavaScript is disabled?

answers.question: Define Streaming SSR.
answers.answer: A complex system design problem requiring deep architectural knowledge.

sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Node Server
  C->>S: GET /
  S-->>C: HTML chunk 1 (Header)
  Note over S: Server fetches heavy DB data
  S-->>C: HTML chunk 2 (Main Content)
  S-->>C: HTML chunk 3 (Footer)
  Note over C: Connection closed
